source_claim: AlphaEvolve prompts can include concrete SEARCH/REPLACE examples, but generated proposals should edit the current program rather than copying illustrative prompt examples as candidate patches
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve manifests include runtime.history.prompt_example_copy_report for built-in mutation example inventories plus exact, normalized-region, and example-format skeleton copy diagnostics with candidate status, mutation mode, and sample record evidence. It does not claim hard or configurable rejection policy, semantic or renamed copy detection, custom prompt-template example inventories, per-template source mapping, cross-run copy-rate tables, copy-signal-to-acceptance outcome policy, or prompt-example revision guidance.
